Twombly v. Bell Atlantic Corp.
313 F.Supp.2d 174 (S.D.N.Y. 2003)
United States District Court, S.D. New York.

LYNCH, District Judge.
Plaintiffs allege that the defendants conspired. Factual allegations must be enough to raise a right to relief above the speculative level, as the Supreme Court later put it in Bell Atlantic Corp. v. Twombly, 550 U.S. 544 (2007).
